dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' shaped annuli exhibit serrated or scalloped outer perimeters. The gradient transition consists of a thin, high-intensity light-colored boundary contrasting sharply against the dark-intensity base coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid low-intensity pixel clusters; the majority of the texture is comprised of hollow-center annuli rather than solid blobs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of three large annuli located in the mid-dorsal region, with a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli forming a trapezoidal relationship on the posterior lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Parallel vertical linear striations are visible on the lateral neck region, likely corresponding to physiological skin folds.
